notes:
- New player models for co-op teammates: detailed, layered survivors (boots with soles and laces, cargo
  pants with pockets and knee pads, belt, buckle and holster, shirt, tactical vest with mag pouches, straps
  and radio, armband, gloves, backpack with bedroll, and a full face with eyes, brows, nose, ears and jaw).
  - Arms use two-bone IK, so both hands sit on the gun's grip and foregrip, for every weapon.
  - Animated walk/run and sprint cycles, crouch, aim pitch through spine, chest and head, aiming down
    sights, muzzle flash and recoil, and a last-stand downed pose (sat back on one arm, pistol up).
  - Name tags show level and rank.
- Customization with level unlocks: new CUSTOMIZE screen on the main menu with a live 3D preview.
  - 8 outfits, 9 headgear (beanie, cap, bandana, helmet, hood, gas mask, beret, skull mask...),
    10 weapon camos (Woodland to Plasma; Gold, Diamond and Plasma at high levels), 6 skin tones and
    6 armband colours.
  - Teammates see your look. Your first-person sleeves/gloves match your outfit and your guns wear your camo.
  - The game-over screen lists what you unlocked when you level up.
- Crouch: hold Ctrl or toggle with C. Slower movement, lower view, and you can't stand up under low
  ceilings. Teammates see you crouch.
- Power-ups dropped outside the barricades now float in through the nearest window of an open room.
